title: Word statistics
description:
Report on the words of a sentence with methods and a list.

```
Text: the cat sat on the mat
Words: 6
Unique: 5
Longest: the
Average length: 2.83
```
hints: A `HashSet<string>` keeps one copy of each word: `new HashSet<string>(words).Count`.
For the longest word, loop and replace only when `w.Length > best.Length`.
requirements: Write `static`-style local methods `CountUnique(string[] words)` and `Longest(string[] words)` (first wins on ties).
Print the average length with two decimals.
stretch: Make the counts ignore case with `StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase`.
